notes.subject: tsedeke
notes.rationale: צדקה e dula e le tsedeke ka ho latela molao oa puo, eseng 'toka' feela

notes.subject: יביעו
notes.rationale: tlhaho: ho phunyeletsa ntho e metsi; Sesotho 'phatlalatsa' — sehla sa metsi se timetse

notes.subject: זכר רב
notes.rationale: kakaretso ea sepetla se moholo — bobeli ba lentswe le le mong ba Sesotho 'o moholo'

translation: Sepetla sa mohau oa hao o moholo ba tla se phatlalatsa, mme tsedeke ea hao ba tla e opela ka thabo.

tokens.gloss: ba tla e opela ka thabo
